sar_narrative: The account for SYN_12c66ba8, an import-export firm, exhibits activity consistent with layering and pass-through behavior. Between February and April 2026, the entity conducted 40 transactions totaling $2,383,321.30, primarily via wire transfers (85% channel mix). Notable transfers include $100,924.20 to UAVC Partners LLC (2026-03-11) and $100,781.73 to EWVZ Solutions LLC (2026-04-26). This rapid movement of funds across 37 unique counterparties warrants further review. This matter is referred to a human investigator.
